description: After the target API decision is implemented: README and docs/language.md sections on portable vs architecture builds (when to pick which, how to check it helped with report: :full, how to deploy, what a mismatch error looks like); compile and load errors in the defk-vku format with codes in the catalogue. Then a cold test like defk-dig (fresh session, docs only): set up a project, switch to an architecture build, ship a release to a different machine profile, and record every point of confusion. Fix or ticket each.
title: Devex: document and cold-test the chosen target API
